facts.zx01-gp1-kla-scale-transfer--name: ZX01 GP-1 transfer from nominal 5 L to 500 L
facts.zx01-gp1-kla-scale-transfer--description: Four-scale batch fermentation verification compares GP-1 concentration and logarithmic-phase kLa for the same reported ZX01 strain.

zx01-gp1-kla-scale-transfer--process_con.summary: Glycoprotein GP-1 batch fermentation at bench and pilot scales; agitation was adjusted to obtain similar kLa. The scale-dependent inoculum and vessel systems are not claimed identical.

zx01-gp1-kla-scale-transfer--comparisons.comparability_basis: The same reported strain was assessed in repeated verification batches at four vessel sizes, using similar kLa as the transfer criterion.
zx01-gp1-kla-scale-transfer--comparisons.interpretation: These reported batch averages support this study-specific transfer comparison. They do not isolate vessel size from agitation, geometry or inoculum differences.
